prediction_text: Positive on all four parts: (1) He shall be rich, and shall subsist of himself without depending on marriage for wealth. (2) The means are his own trade/calling and industry — Mars lord of the 2nd and of the Part of Fortune in the Ascendant shows wealth coming by his own labour and business, aided by Jupiter exalted and angular in the 10th (credit, reputation and preferment through his vocation), not primarily by a wife's portion. (3) When: gradual, not immediate — the Moon, lady of the 10th, applying to conjunction of Venus lady of the Ascendant and wanting 6°27' gives the main timing coordinate at about six to seven years to the fuller attainment, within a year-scale window of the first several years of trading. (4) It shall continue: the cusp of the 2nd in a fixed sign and the Part of Fortune in a fixed sign in the terms of Mars give durability — wealth once gotten is kept, at a substantial tradesman level, not a merely subsisting level.
basis: Lilly 2nd-house horary: Venus lady Asc near Regulus; Mars lord 2nd and lord of Fortune in Asc near Spica; Jupiter in exaltation (Cancer) angular near culmination; Moon lady 10th separating from sextile Mars and conjunction Mercury, applying to Venus wanting 6°27'; fixed 2nd cusp and fixed Fortune for continuance. Level calibration: multiple angular/exalted testimonies with no stated debility of the wealth significators justify a full 'rich' level, no downgrading.
